scope: Independent appearance review of the frozen round-3 native Sessions and People bundle, retaining the complete iPhone shell. No prior review, score, plan, implementation source, or other reviewer output was consulted.
scenario: Independent recruiter reopening the right conversation or person; iPhone 17, iOS 26.5 Simulator, portrait, synthetic workspace, English light and Simplified Chinese dark at default size, English AX5 including later scroll positions. No interruption or input was performed by this reviewer.
evidence_level: Screenshots only, supplemented by the explicitly supplied behavioral summary in review-input.md. All ten uncropped PNGs were inspected with view_image. Confidence about behavior is capped at supported_inference.

categories.name: Attention and clarity
evidence: 01-sessions-light.png: bold topic is the first read, followed by person/search context and then recency plus explicit Review needed.
02-sessions-unread-light.png and 05-sessions-dark-zh.png: explicit Unread/未读 is independent of Review needed/待你确认; a read item can still require review.

03-people-light.png, 04-people-filter.png, and 06-people-dark-zh.png: person name leads; job/company, search relationship, and recency remain subordinate and readable. The filtered result has an explicit removable scope chip.
07-sessions-ax5.png through 10-people-ax5-scrolled.png: primary identity/topic stays visually stronger than the count and synthetic preview label.

deductions.observation: The persistent bottom Ask anything composer remains a second wide rounded input surface alongside the top Search control. At AX5 its enlarged wording has appreciable visual weight during a retrieval-only scan, although the two labels are distinct and no mistaken behavior is demonstrated.
image_evidence: 07-sessions-ax5.png: top Search sessions and fixed bottom Ask anything
08-people-ax5.png: top Search people and fixed bottom Ask anything
10-people-ax5-scrolled.png: the composer remains prominent during the later list position

categories.name: Typography and legibility
evidence: 01-sessions-light.png and 03-people-light.png: comfortable topic/name, context, and metadata hierarchy; no essential ellipsis in the visible rows.
05-sessions-dark-zh.png and 06-people-dark-zh.png: mixed-script content remains legible, with clearly readable Chinese controls and metadata.

07-sessions-ax5.png and 09-sessions-ax5-scrolled.png: long topic/context text wraps, and the later position exposes Review needed and recency. The first viewport boundary is not evidence of inaccessible clipping.
08-people-ax5.png and 10-people-ax5-scrolled.png: large names, company context, and search association are retained without horizontal truncation.

deductions.observation: At AX5 the job/company block uses near-name-scale dark text. Nia's four-line Operating Partner / Northlight Capital block becomes a substantial competing text mass, while Leila's role/company also closely approaches the name's emphasis. Bold still distinguishes the names; this is a small hierarchy refinement, not a complaint that large text scrolls.
image_evidence: 08-people-ax5.png: Leila Hartmann and VP Product · Meridian Labs
10-people-ax5-scrolled.png: Nia Williams above the four-line Operating Partner · Northlight Capital block

categories.name: Alignment and rhythm
evidence: 01-sessions-light.png and 02-sessions-unread-light.png: topic, context, and metadata retain the same left inset through the read/unread surface change; menus stay at a consistent trailing location.
03-people-light.png, 04-people-filter.png, and 06-people-dark-zh.png: initials, name/context column, menus, and dividers form coherent rows, including the single-result state.

07-sessions-ax5.png through 10-people-ax5-scrolled.png: full-width text stacking is consistent after the compact avatar layout gives way to large type; metadata remains grouped with its record. Visible top/bottom partial lines occur at the List viewport boundaries.
01-sessions-light.png through 06-people-dark-zh.png: the unused lower area truthfully reflects sparse data; no filler or stranded extra metadata line is introduced.

categories.name: Restraint and material
evidence: 01-sessions-light.png and 03-people-light.png: warm neutral field, limited dividers, useful menus and retrieval icons, and no row-navigation chevrons or decorative agent object.
02-sessions-unread-light.png and 05-sessions-dark-zh.png: unread alone receives a raised/tinted row treatment, while operational attention uses scarce red text plus a distinct dotted symbol.
06-people-dark-zh.png: dark material remains quiet and avoids adding cards around every person.

deductions.observation: The light unread card's diffuse shadow creates a broader halo than the row needs to communicate its state. Its explicit Unread label and surface fill already carry that meaning; the dark unread treatment is more restrained. This is a minor material preference, not an unread-semantics failure.
image_evidence: 02-sessions-unread-light.png: soft halo outside Leila's white unread card, especially below it
05-sessions-dark-zh.png: Nia's unread state uses a quiet tonal surface with explicit 未读

categories.name: System coherence
evidence: 01-sessions-light.png and 03-people-light.png: consistent tab shell, search, filter, count, synthetic preview label, row menus, and bottom composer across both pages.
04-people-filter.png: active filter icon, explicit search-scope chip with close affordance, and updated singular count make the visible filtered state understandable.
05-sessions-dark-zh.png and 06-people-dark-zh.png: localized navigation and retrieval utilities preserve the same structure and legible dark palette.
07-sessions-ax5.png and 08-people-ax5.png: tabs, search/filter, identity, and row menus survive the large-type layout.

09-sessions-ax5-scrolled.png and 10-people-ax5-scrolled.png: later positions expose the first session's attention/recency and the next person respectively. These support a credible scrolling layout without certifying every interaction.

score_interpretation: Subjective craft judgment using the frozen five-category anchors; not a usability measurement, cross-reviewer average, or release approval. No category deduction is assigned for legitimate AX5 scrolling or honest sparse data.

highest_impact_corrections.correction: At accessibility sizes, give People job/company text a modestly quieter semantic hierarchy while retaining full Dynamic Type scaling and all identity/context text.
highest_impact_corrections.verification: Compare full uncropped default/AX5 People screens; names should remain the first read while every company and search association remains available by natural scrolling. Do not solve this with line limits or a fixed font cap.

highest_impact_corrections.correction: Explore a lower-emphasis presentation of the global composer during retrieval scrolling, preserving a clear, accessible route to it and the existing search/filter functions.
highest_impact_corrections.verification: Review the complete shell and observe find-and-reopen tasks at AX5; retain the current presentation if lowering emphasis harms discovery, adds retrieval friction, or hides an essential control.

highest_impact_corrections.correction: Reduce the light unread card shadow's spread/intensity slightly while preserving its surface distinction and explicit unread label.
highest_impact_corrections.verification: Compare read, unread-only, review-only, and combined states in light and dark; unread must remain identifiable without relying on the shadow or color alone.

functional_gates.evidence: review-input.md reports focused policy and native checks including localized People role query and compact People search. 04-people-filter.png shows a coherent filtered result, but not the input transition.
review-input.md reports passing exact search/filter/reset checks. No empty-result or reset transition is included in the ten PNGs.
01-sessions-light.png, 02-sessions-unread-light.png, and 05-sessions-dark-zh.png separate unread from review attention; review-input.md reports the composition test and CUA state readback.
review-input.md reports native hittability and the 0.001-point numeric tolerance for a 44-point frame; still PNGs do not independently prove hit regions.
The frozen input reports native UI checks; 01-sessions-light.png and 03-people-light.png show the two selected destinations, not a navigation recording.

07-sessions-ax5.png plus 09-sessions-ax5-scrolled.png expose session continuation, and 08-people-ax5.png plus 10-people-ax5-scrolled.png show the next person. The input reports CUA Scroll Down and restoration checks. Nia's last recency line remains below the captured boundary in 10; its final position was not independently inspected.
Identity and search context stay consistent in 01 through 10. review-input.md states no intended identity/provenance semantics change; screenshots do not establish storage or source integrity.
review-input.md limits these pages to retrieval with no external action. No resulting external write is depicted; absence of writes cannot be certified from still images.

missing_evidence: No direct interaction or raw native test log inspection by this reviewer; behavioral results above are attributed to the frozen input.
No VoiceOver traversal/user test, focus or keyboard recording, measured performance, interruption/error recovery, small-device or landscape coverage in this image bundle.
No first-use recruiter study supports a measured retrieval success claim. Token contrast formulas in the input are not a rendered accessibility certification.
